# HR Niti — GenAI Powered HRMS & Payroll Software in India

> HR Niti is India's leading cloud-based HRMS (Human Resource Management System) & Payroll Software platform powered by Generative AI. It automates multi-state payroll, attendance tracking (with mobile GPS & geofencing), leave management, statutory compliance (PF, ESIC, PT, MLWF, LWF), recruitment, performance management, and HR analytics for Indian enterprises, SMEs, and startups.

## Core Platform Capabilities

- **Payroll Automation**: 1-click automated salary calculation with Indian statutory compliance (PF, ESIC, PT, MLWF, Form 16, Form 24Q) and direct ICICI/HDFC bank integrations.
- **Attendance & Leave Management**: Mobile app attendance with GPS geofencing, facial recognition support, real-time biometrics integration, and customizable leave policies.
- **Statutory Compliance engine**: State-specific compliance rules covering all 28 states and 8 union territories (Maharashtra, Karnataka, Telangana, Tamil Nadu, Delhi NCR, Gujarat, West Bengal, etc.).
- **GenAI HR Assistant**: AI-powered HR chatbot for employee self-service, policy inquiry, leave requests, and instant payroll summaries.
- **Performance & Recruitment**: OKR/KPI tracking, continuous feedback, full recruitment funnel management, applicant tracking, and automated offer letters.
